translated_title: Possible Return of Enrique Inzunza to the Senate Divides Morena Legislators
original_title: Posible regreso de Enrique Inzunza al Senado divide a legisladores de Morena
author: Georgina Saldierna and Enrique Méndez
meta_description: With the session opening Sept. 1, Morena is split over whether the Sinaloa senator, flagged by US authorities over alleged cartel ties, should take leave or show up.
image_warnings: La Jornada featured Cloudflare-blocked; used CC0 portrait of Sen. Inzunza (Gov. of Sinaloa / Wikimedia). Note: vertical 1066×1600 — reply /fotos if you want a landscape image.
